Dialga

Steel Dragon

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Legendary Pokémon

Dialga is a Steel/Dragon-type Temporal Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 5.4 m tall and weighs 683 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (150), with a base stat total of 680.
